Antimicrobial crosswalk: BNF chemical substances and AMR package antimicrobials

Source: R/crosswalk.R
antibiotic_crosswalk.Rd

One row per BNF chemical substance that corresponds to an antimicrobial agent in the AMR package. Built from the chemical substances present in the NHS Business Services Authority English Prescribing Dataset (December 2025 and June 2026) by matching names with AMR::as.ab(), rejecting fuzzy false positives, and applying a short manual override table (data-raw/manual_overrides.csv). Several BNF chemicals can map to one AMR agent (salts and routes, for example doxycycline hyclate and monohydrate), and one agent can appear in several BNF chapters (systemic in chapter 5; eye, ear, skin and vaginal products in chapters 7, 11, 12 and 13).

Usage

antibiotic_crosswalk

Format

A data frame with columns:

bnf_chemical_code

9-character BNF chemical substance code.

bnf_name

BNF chemical substance name.

bnf_chapter, bnf_section, bnf_paragraph

BNF chapter (2), section (4) and paragraph (6) codes.

ab

AMR package antimicrobial code (for example "AMX").

ab_name

AMR antimicrobial name.

ab_group

AMR antimicrobial group(s), separated by " | ".

atc

Primary human ATC code (systemic J... code preferred); can be NA.

atc_all

All human ATC codes for the agent, separated by "|".

match_method

"AMR::as.ab" (name matching) or "manual".

amr_version

Version of the AMR package used to build the table.

Source

NHSBSA English Prescribing Dataset, BNF chemical substances (Open Government Licence v3.0); AMR package antimicrobials dataset.

Details

Scope: antibacterials (including antimycobacterials) and antifungals, plus topical anti-infectives. Antivirals and antiparasitics are not included because the AMR package keeps them in separate datasets (as.av()).

Examples

head(antibiotic_crosswalk[, c("bnf_chemical_code", "bnf_name", "ab", "atc")])
#>   bnf_chemical_code                               bnf_name  ab     atc
#> 1         0501011J0 Benzylpenicillin sodium (Penicillin G) PEN J01CE01
#> 2         0501011P0 Phenoxymethylpenicillin (Penicillin V) PHN J01CE02
#> 3         0501012G0                  Flucloxacillin sodium FLC J01CF05
#> 4         0501013B0                            Amoxicillin AMX J01CA04
#> 5         0501013C0                     Amoxicillin sodium AMX J01CA04
#> 6         0501013E0                             Ampicillin AMP J01CA01
